Proposition
[Smoothness of the Unnormalized Gram--Schmidt Sections]

↗ def:pseudo-gram-schmidt-frame ↗ def:local-nondegenerate-family ↗ lem:pseudo-metric-pairing-smooth ↗ lem:pseudo-gram-schmidt-denominators

Each section $U_j$ is smooth on $u$.

Proof

↗ def:pseudo-gram-schmidt-frame ↗ lem:pseudo-metric-pairing-smooth ↗ lem:pseudo-gram-schmidt-denominators \sketch Use strong induction in the recursion

\[ U_j=X_j-\sum _{i<j} \frac{g(U_i,X_j)}{g(U_i,U_i)}U_i. \]

The inductive hypothesis and Lemma 3 make each numerator and denominator smooth, and Lemma 2 makes every denominator nonvanishing. Thus all coefficients and $U_j$ are smooth.

□
